book.name: SUMBAOGHA
book.title: Allahri Imap So'oap Sumbaogha Sembe Musari Mome Toro Pibog Yubu

content: Abram elkel Sarai neneko me mangaroan koma wamog. Wamekti Mesir kel nhon si Hagar el arukna wamog.

Wamekti Sarai nenekori Abramag ambarelamogti, “Nuni Allahri nanag, 'Me mangaro alul kom,' senelamlaba an nari arukna aneap maptumunba eldi me nhon mangkatnelul senelamna,” aro ambarogpa Abramdi, “Wali leplam,” seog.
Wene seogpa Sarai nenekori, “Na arukna toro alulam,” aro Abram tarog. Tarog li eneko Abram Kanaan wamog paghabog heng kun taibuka taubuka ulamogha heng kun sa'obare taog.
Abram neneko Hagarap maptekpa me monag wamogpa, “Me monag wamnel,” aro Hagar el taogti Hagar neneko omektangto, nongkotno aro Sarai mombolag nenelamog.

Mombolag nenelamogpa Sarai nenekori Abramag yubu lelamogti, “Nari arukna Hagar neneko nari tatkenoba me monag taonge neneko el taori na mombolag nenelamnel. Andi uaomne neneri na mali nenelamnel. Ane sembe tam nun phendeag wamlange nene Nuni Allahri og tam karebalul,” seog.
Wene seogpa Abramdi, “El neneko an arukna wamlaba an saeag wamla. Andi sembamlamne wali elag ualulam,” aro ambarogpa Sarai nenekori Hagar nenekoag yonge maikno ulamogpa logti lambaog.
Lambaogti palamogti mog so'o Syur pirobag aldesag mag lu pirobag piogti wamogpa Nuni Allahri Ilipsae arukna malaikat nhon poghogpa Hagarag yaogti
yubu lelamogti, “Sarai arukna Hagar, an talaba yalamdi, 'Tala punun,' aro ulamlam?” aro haibaogpa, Hagar nenekori, “Na logti Sarai neneko laploa yalamna,” seog.
Wene seogpa Allah arukna anekori, “Samoro elag pimendi wamlulam, wali an eldi mombolag nenelangkilul,” aro wene seogti nen yubu lelamogti,
“Nari an mikip nembahineba andi mangarobari mangkahyikne taneko maikno taikpa nimiri a'ilbahinep kom wamlul.
Olog wapmena me nengabo me mangaro alulam. Mangaro amendi, 'Na mali uro wamnaba Nani Allahri ka'ebaneori me nengabo me tatnel,' aro me si Ismael
An anme neneko pham pai pham
saog uro haing whi wamleri elkaboap ni aisa neneptangto wamikpa eldi, 'Nimi opsinun,' aro ulamleba sindi babe, 'El obukap,' aro ulamukang,” aro ambarog.
Ambarogpa Hagar neneko wana-ag agha hailtalamogti, “Allah kemelamnelne neneko sumene imna, welaro amik el si engkanun?” aro “El-roi” aro engkaog.
Ane sembe mag so'o waliropne Kades anabi Bered anabiag mag so'o waliropne neneko sina, “Beer-lahai-roi,” engkaog.
Nen Saraiag sambaogti, olog wamogha Hagar nenekori me nengabo me mangaroaogpa Ili Abram ponekori me si Ismael engkaog.
Me si Ismael engkaog li eneko Abram heng kun mangaro yabiogne teng wilindi eptopne lambare (86) wamog.

footnotes.text: Ibrani yubuag, “Allahri ka'ebaneo,” aro me si Ismael engkaog.
“Pai pham” Ibraninangdi yubuag “pham 'keledai' pai pham,” aro engerop.
Ibrani yubuagna si “El-roi” aro engeropne, “Allah kemelamsilne” aro engerop.
Ibrani yubuagna, “Allah ya'ag kamag uropne ponekori imneoghag” aro si “Beer-lahai-roi” aro engerop.
